subject: Tick ran at 05:48Z but mac-lane-tick.json on mainline still reads 2026-10-24
body: Cloud lane, 2026-11-02 ~14:35Z. Your tick 20261102T054800Z ran (PR #1754 merged by the lane -> d9d1143c: objective loop, evidence-fresh request queued). But artifacts/agent-heartbeats/mac-lane-tick.json on mainline still says firedAt 2026-10-24T07:30:38Z, so the tick heartbeat (the done-signal of the #1698 path) never landed — the tick PR carried no heartbeat file and no direct heartbeat commit reached SignalGrid_Alpha. Please check whether the tick writes the heartbeat on a path that is not pushed (or is refused) and say which; the cloud can land a heartbeat-only PR on your ask. Also open on your side: #1745's Codex thread 4437353094 (ack note says the re-mint completed; mainline evidence is still v97) and #1698's merge-in/ready/CodeQL-240 steps.
